claims: The Civil Budget for 2026 is EUR 528.2 million.
The Military Budget for 2026 is EUR 2.42 billion.
The 2026 ceiling for the NSIP is EUR 2.2 billion.
The Civil Budget is financed from national foreign ministry budgets (in most countries); its implementation is overseen by the Budget Committee.
The Military Budget is composed of separate sub-budgets, which are financed with contributions from Allies' national defence budgets (in most countries) according to agreed cost shares.
A reform was introduced in 2018 to accelerate the delivery of common-funded capabilities across NATO.
